result.summary: Updates draft release note snippets to include their pull request numbers, adjusts a version reference from 32.0 to 32.1, and updates developer documentation accordingly. It also introduces a lint check enforcing that all release note snippet files reference their PR.
result.problem: Release note snippets often omit pull request numbers and contained outdated target versions, complicating tracking and release note compilation. Without automated enforcement, snippets can be merged without a PR reference.
evidence: PR description: "Add some missing PR #s (needed if #36769 happens more)."
result.changed_since_previous: Added developer guidance in doc/developer-notes.md and a Rust linter check in test/lint/test_runner/src/lint_docs.rs to enforce PR references in release note snippets.
result.card: Updates release note snippets to include pull request numbers and correct a version string from 32.0 to 32.1. It also adds a Rust linter check that requires all release note snippets to reference their pull request, and updates developer documentation accordingly. This prevents snippets from landing without PR attribution and eases release note assembly.

risk.why: A flaw in the linter rule could cause false positives in CI when validating release note snippets.
